item.title: The UAE’s Federal Authority for Artificial Intelligence and Data
item.description:
# The UAE’s Federal Authority for Artificial Intelligence and Data The United Arab Emirates recently took an important initial step in bringing artificial intelligence, data governance and digital government under a single authority. His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum approved the establishment of the Federal Authority for Artificial Intelligence and Data, a national body reporting directly to the UAE Cabinet.
### Established Frameworks This direction is also reflected in the UAE Cabinet’s recent launch of its AI Advisor system, which brings agentic AI directly into government decision making within a governed framework.
